facts.activity_file: working live under a documented justification

control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment

facts.title: audit finding - management of change not applied to G-8102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on G-8102 and TT-8102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. G-8102 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 22 August 2016 a planned critical control verification of G-8102 and TT-8102 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station found the arc flash boundary and protective equipment not effective.
